description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView widget that implements the LogNode interface for displaying log data received from Android's logging system. It formats log entries with different severity levels, handles exceptions, and supports chaining of LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView widget that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface, formatting log messages with priority levels, tags, and optional exceptions, and supporting chainable log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data based on priority, tag, message, and Throwable, then updates the LogView display on the UI thread, and forwards the log message to the next LogNode if configured.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null; used internally for constructing log output.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
